requirements.title: IMU App Execution Rate
requirements.description: The IMU app shall execute at 200 Hz on the static schedule.
requirements.rationale: Derived from SYS-005 200 Hz IMU sample rate; the app drives per-cycle library reads.

requirements.title: IMU Sample Read Per Cycle
requirements.description: The IMU app shall read one IMU sample from the IMU library on each scheduled cycle.
requirements.rationale: Derived from SYS-001 raw sensor logging path; one sample per 200 Hz tick supports full-rate logging.

requirements.title: IMU Message Publication
requirements.description: The IMU app shall publish each IMU sample as a structured message on the software bus.
requirements.rationale: Derived from SYS-001; downstream nav, logging, and telemetry apps consume IMU samples via the bus.

requirements.title: Monotonic Timestamp on IMU Message
requirements.description: The IMU app shall stamp each published IMU message with monotonic microseconds since startup.
requirements.rationale: Derived from SYS-026 single monotonic time base and SYS-027 per-sample timestamping.

requirements.title: Pass-Through Sample Content
requirements.description: The IMU app shall publish IMU samples without filtering, integration, or other transformation.
requirements.rationale: PM-defined view-layer scope; the IMU app is pass-through with no business logic.

requirements.title: Body-Frame Axis Convention in Message
requirements.description: The IMU app shall report accelerometer and gyroscope vectors in the X-forward, Y-right, Z-down frame.
requirements.rationale: Derived from SYS-057 body axes convention so consumers receive samples in the documented frame.

requirements.title: IMU Health Publication
requirements.description: The IMU app shall publish IMU health status on the software bus on each scheduled cycle.
requirements.rationale: Derived from SYS-031 continuous sensor health bitmap; sys_app aggregates per-sensor health from the bus.

requirements.title: Deterministic IMU App Behavior
requirements.description: The IMU app shall produce identical published messages given identical library sample inputs.
requirements.rationale: Derived from SYS-044 determinism; supports repeatable Trick simulation.

requirements.title: Accelerometer Range Verification
requirements.description: The IMU app shall verify the accelerometer range is configured to plus or minus 16 G.
requirements.rationale: Derived from SYS-006; the app verifies the library configuration matches the FT1 flight envelope.

requirements.title: Gyroscope Range Verification
requirements.description: The IMU app shall verify the gyroscope range is configured to plus or minus 2000 dps.
requirements.rationale: Derived from SYS-007; the app verifies the library configuration matches the FT1 rotation envelope.
